typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		CompositeKey as string,
		Bank as string,
		CCY as string,
		StatementDate as date,
		LedgerBalance as string,
		StatementBalance as string,
		USD_eqv as string,
		Annual_ODIR as string,
		OD_USD_eqv as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> RetrieveLatestStatementData	source(output(
		SourceCompositeKey as string,
		ListTag as string,
		TextTag as string,
		LastEditedUser as string,
		LastEditedDate as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> RetrieveTags
RetrieveLatestStatementData sort(asc(CompositeKey, false),asc(Bank, false),asc(CCY, false),asc(StatementDate, false),asc(LedgerBalance, false),asc(StatementBalance, false),asc(USD_eqv, false),asc(Annual_ODIR, false),asc(OD_USD_eqv, false)) ~> Aggregate
RetrieveTags sort(asc(SourceCompositeKey, false)) ~> Sort1
Aggregate window(over(CompositeKey,
		Bank,
		CCY,
		StatementDate,
		LedgerBalance,
		StatementBalance,
		USD_eqv,
		Annual_ODIR,
		OD_USD_eqv),
	asc(CompositeKey, true),
	asc(Bank, true),
	asc(CCY, true),
	asc(StatementDate, true),
	asc(LedgerBalance, true),
	asc(StatementBalance, true),
	asc(USD_eqv, true),
	asc(Annual_ODIR, true),
	asc(OD_USD_eqv, true),
	Rank_col = rowNumber()) ~> Aggregatedistinct
Aggregatedistinct filter(Rank_col == 1) ~> Aggregatedistinct0
Aggregatedistinct0 sort(asc(CompositeKey, false)) ~> Sort
Sort,Sort1 join(CompositeKey == SourceCompositeKey,
	joinType:'left',
	broadcast: 'none')~> MergeJoin
MergeJoin derive(CompositeKey = CompositeKey,
		SourceCompositeKey = SourceCompositeKey,
		Bank = Bank,
		CCY = CCY,
		StatementDate = StatementDate,
		LedgerBalance = LedgerBalance,
		StatementBalance = StatementBalance,
		USD_eqv = USD_eqv,
		Annual_ODIR = Annual_ODIR,
		OD_USD_eqv = OD_USD_eqv,
		ListTag = ListTag,
		TextTag = TextTag) ~> MergeJoin0
MergeJoin0 derive(ProcessingDate = currentTimestamp()) ~> AddProcessingDate
AddProcessingDate sink(input(
		Comment as string,
		OD_USD_eqv as string,
		Bank as string,
		DaysOD as string,
		LedgerBalance as integer,
		Annual_ODIR as string,
		CCY as string,
		StatementDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		ProcessingDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		StatementBalance as integer,
		USD_eqv as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,errorHandlingOption: 'allErrors', outputRejectedData: true,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Comment = TextTag,
		OD_USD_eqv,
		Bank,
		DaysOD = ListTag,
		LedgerBalance,
		Annual_ODIR,
		CCY,
		StatementDate,
		ProcessingDate,
		StatementBalance,
		USD_eqv),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
